titulo: Trustee exculpation-the law, the quirks and the business sense
resumo: Trustee exculpation clauses: the law as it stands-what duties/liabilities fall outside the standard clause and/or cannot be lawfully excluded: the meaning of 'wilful default'-how far it extends in practice-the borderline with dishonesty. To what extent can the supine trustee rely on a clause which excepts wilful default? See the Weavering decision. Is the 'wilful default' standard applied differently depending on remuneration, professional, and business experience? Points arising on fraud or dishonesty. Are wide-form exculpation clauses a bad thing? Special considerations affecting professional trustees: the standards applicable, and whether such clauses relied on by professional trustees bring the trust industry into disrepute. The need to explain the clause to the settlor and solicitors' potential liability for not doing so.
justificativa_ia1: O objeto B trata inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/habital e a figura do devedor contumaz. O artigo em questão discute cláusulas exculpatorias, o conceito de 'wilful default' e questões de má-fé/dishonestidade no contexto de trustees, o que pode ou não representar, de forma direta, inadimplemento deliberado do devedor conforme o enquadramento de B. A pertinência depende de como o texto define e aplica 'default' no âmbito fiduciário, requerendo leitura mais detalhada para confirmar relação explícita com o devedor contumaz/recorrente (valor, reiteração, injustificabilidade). Por isso, decisão é de dúvida (dúvida).
justificativa_ia2: O artigo trata de cláusulas de exoneração de responsabilidade de trustees e da definição/alcance de 'wilful default' no contexto fiduciário e de trust law. Não aborda inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico de devedores, nem a figura do devedor contumaz/recorrente nem critérios de enquadramento (valor, reiteração, injustificabilidade). Enquadra-se em tema fiduciário sem conexão com o objeto da revisão, pelo que é excluído (EC-B2).

titulo: Ng Chee Tian & Anor v Ng Chee Pong & 2 Ors [2025] SGHC 246: fiduciary discipline in family estate administration: trustees' duties to account and get in assets
resumo: Ng Chee Tian & Anor v Ng Chee Pong & 2 Ors [2025] SGHC 246 clarifies trustees' duties to account and get in estate assets in the context of informal family administration, joint accounts, and incomplete records. It also elucidates the interaction between resulting trusts, advancement, and survivorship, while reaffirming the central role of falsification, surcharging, and wilful default accounts as tools of fiduciary enforcement, including the court's willingness to proceed directly to consequential relief where accounting material is sufficient.
justificativa_ia1: O caso trata de deveres fiduciários e de mecanismos de enforcement em administração de patrimônio/família, incluindo contas por inadimplemento voluntário (wilful/default) como ferramenta de enforcement, além de abordar o relacionamento entre trusts, adiantamentos e sobrevivência. Esses elementos atestam pertinência ao objeto de inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/hábito e à figura do devedor contumaz.
justificativa_ia2: Caso em inglês sobre disciplina fiduciária e deveres de trustees na administração de espólios (falsificação, surcharging e 'wilful default' em contexto de trust). Trata de incumprimento fiduciário, não de inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico de devedores nem da figura do devedor contumaz (critérios de valor, reiteração ou injustificabilidade). Portanto, não é pertinente ao objeto da busca.

titulo: NON-PERFORMING ASSETS: A CASE STUDY OF SYNDICATE BANK
resumo: The banking sectors are act as catalyst in achieving rapid economic development of a country. They act as an intermediary to mobilize the excess fund of surplus sectors to provide necessary finance to those sectors, which are needed to promote for the sound development of the economy. The sound financial position of a bank depends upon the recovery of loans or its level of Non-performing assets (NPAs). Therefore the study of non-performing assets of Banks assumes a great importance in a developing economy. The present study is on NonPerforming assets: A case study of Syndicate Bank over the period of five years (2011-2015). The research paper is based on the secondary data. The collected data is analyzed using mean, percentage. Regression, Student t-test and one way Anova test. The study concluded that NPAs are draining the capital of the banks and weakening their financial strength. Management of non-performing assets is a difficult task for every bank in the banking industry. Willful defaults, improper processing of loan proposals, poor monitoring and so on are the causes for accounts becoming NPAs. Therefore, banks must take more care in avoiding any account becoming NPA by taking proper preventive measures in an efficient manner.

justificativa_ia1: O artigo analisa ativos não performantes (NPAs) em um banco específico e afirma que 'willful defaults' (inadimplemento deliberado) são uma das causas de NPAs, atendendo ao objeto da Busca B (inadimplemento deliberado, estratégico ou habitual; devedor contumaz/recorrente). Não se aplica EC-B1 (idioma é inglês, permitido) nem EC-B2 (pertinência ao tema). Não pertence ao escopo de modelagem macroeconômica de risco de crédito sem inadimplemento deliberado, nem trata inadimplemento incidental não intencional ou temas fiduciários sem conexão com inadimplemento deliberado.
justificativa_ia2: Estudo é um caso geral sobre NPAs com análise estatística; apenas menciona ‘willful defaults’ como uma das causas sem tratar especificamente de inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/habitual, nem da figura do devedor contumaz ou critérios de enquadramento (valor, reiteração, injustificabilidade). Portanto não é pertinente ao objeto da Busca B.

titulo: Regional rural banks and their performance - An empirical study
resumo: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) are formed to serve the needy rural poor for agricultural and allied activity and non-farm sector capital requirements. It is well known that the lenders are the sufferers from non-recovery of loans lent to wilful defaulters and cheaters. The banking system is the heart of any country's economy, striving to achieve growth and remain a permanent and dominating factor in the global competitive business environment. The major part of the Indian banking sector, the commercial and scheduled nationalised and private banks, and cooperative banks play a vital role. But this two-tier mechanism faced problems to satisfy the capital needs to the rural mass. To improve the rural credit mechanism and overcome the inadequate situation, led the Government of India to form a committee to find a feasible solution to facilitate easy rural credit satisfying mechanism through RRBs. In particular, the RRBs mainly focus on mobilisation of savings and supply of credit to the rural people. This paper attempts to study the performance of RRBs for the country as a whole for a period of thirteen years (2001- 14). Indicators analysed for critical looks at the RRBs' performance are the following; No. of RRBs, branches, districts covered, and staff employed (Table 1); sources of funds (owned, borrowed, deposits and total) (Table 4); advances, investments and total applications (Table 7); advances, deposits and CD ratio (Table 9); total sources and total utilisation (Table 10). For the first three Tables mentioned above mean, SD, CV and CAGR are worked out for each indicator. Hypotheses are tested for significance. In the concluding section, suggestions for strengthening the working of RRBs are presented.

justificativa_ia1: O artigo discute o desempenho de Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) e menciona inadimplência de devedores contumazes como problema, mas não esclarece se trata especificamente de inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/habitual nem devedor contumaz como foco central. Dúvida quanto à pertinência ao objeto B; conteúdo pode não abordar de forma substancial o tema de inadimplemento deliberado. Caso o texto completo demonstre abordagem clara ao assunto, a inclusão poderia ser reconsiderada. Practicamente, trata-se de dúvida com base na abstract disponível.
justificativa_ia2: Embora o resumo mencione de forma genérica 'wilful defaulters', o foco do artigo é análise de desempenho macrofinanceiro das Regional Rural Banks (indicadores agregados, testes estatísticos e sugestões institucionais) ao longo de 2001–2014. Não aborda nem operacionaliza inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/habitual, nem trata da figura do devedor contumaz ou critérios de enquadramento (valor, reiteração, injustificabilidade). Portanto, não é pertinente ao objeto da busca B.

titulo: Adequacy of institutional credit through co-operatives in Maharashtra: A region-wise analysis
resumo: An evaluation of the rural credit system of Maharashtra with emphasis on credit delivery system through Primary Agricultural Co-operative Credit Societies (PACS) and other apex institutions in the state and subsequently traverses through region-wise synthesis of credit delivery through PACS overtime with extension to evaluating the influence of various factors on the outstanding loans of these credit institutions has been presented. The credit cooperatives operating in Maharashtra have shown slower growth in institutional finance and faster growth in outstanding loans as against their loan advances during the reform period. The reason behind these problems are associated with adverse environment created by the financial sector reforms, which have reduced the entire rural credit delivery through cooperatives to a moribund state. Also, the cooperatives are also beset with other deficiencies, attributed to low operational efficiency, high incidence of overdues, low level of recovery, distributional aspects of loan advances, and the like. The estimation reveal a wide variation in total and crop loan advances of PACS and the outstanding loans, overdue, and per member borrowing across different regions. The outstanding loan of PACS based on per hectare gross cropped area (GCA) is seen to have exceeded loan advances with a comfortable margin in all the regions of the state. In order to rejuvenate rural credit delivery system through cooperatives, the major problems facing the system need to be tackled with more fiscal jurisprudence reserving exemplary punishment for willful defaults, particularly large farmers focusing on strategies that are required for tackling issues such as sustainability and viability, operational efficiency, recovery performance, small farmer coverage and balanced sectoral development.

justificativa_ia2: Estudo concentra-se na análise do sistema de crédito cooperativo e em variáveis regionais de empréstimos, inadimplência e recuperação; a menção a 'willful defaults' é pontual e normativa (recomendação de punição), sem análise nem enquadramento do inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/contumaz nem critérios de identificação (valor, reiteração, injustificabilidade). Não há pertinência suficiente ao objeto da busca B.

titulo: Integrated approach to institutional finance for agriculture - a case study of three co-operative societies in Sabarkantha district of Gujarat
resumo: This paper focuses on primary agricultural co-operative societies. Agricultural co-operative societies have a primary responsibility of providing crop loans in terms of cash and material, ie agricultural inputs. By doing so they help the farmers in their efforts to raise farm productivity. These co-operative societies have had a mixed performance. The reasons for the poor performance of these societies are identified to be a) wilful default, b) the risky and uncertain nature of agricultural yields, c) phenomenon of price and market uncertainties and d) lack of proper planning by the farmers. The problem becomes more acute in dry regions with the given set of other behavioural parameters. -from Author

justificativa_ia1: O texto cita inadimplemento deliberado como uma das causas do mau desempenho de sociedades cooperativas agrícolas, mas não focaliza nem analisa de forma aprofundada o fenômeno de devedor contumaz/defaulter deliberado. Não está claro se o artigo trata diretamente do enquadramento, critérios (valor, reiteração, injustificabilidade) ou oferece evidência suficiente sobre inadimplemento deliberado, justificando dúvida sobre inclusão.

titulo: A Comparison of Borrowing and Default Behaviour Between Men and Women
resumo: Micro-credit started out as an intervention designed to address credit scarcity of women, purportedly because women are disenfranchised from property rights and adhere to repayment norms. Men, in contrast, were known for misusing the loans and defaulting on them. This paper, based on a sample of 490 men and 349 women drawn from four districts in erstwhile Andhra Pradesh, compares the borrowing and default drivers of men and women using systematic sampling techniques and rigorous statistical tests. Results show women’s disenfranchisement from family income and property, and hence their dependence on SHG membership for borrowing. Furthermore, men borrow from banks and planned repayments even in conditions of distress, where both genders are cost rationed. The findings also point to men co-opting with women for financing agriculture. A comparison of default drivers points to debt traps and lower or inadequate income driving defaults and underscores the asymmetry of information and asymmetry of power between lender–principals and borrower–agents, where the principals have an advantage over the agents in both the cases (Saam, 2007). The paper, therefore, questions the blanket assumptions of compliant repayments by women and wilful defaults by men. JEL codes: D63, D82, J16, Z13, C51 © 2019 SAGE Publications India Pvt. Ltd.
palavras_chave: economic sociology | gender | Inequity | information asymmetry | model construction
justificativa_ia1: O artigo discute comportamento de inadimplência entre homens e mulheres, incluindo a discussão sobre default deliberado e drivers da inadimplência, como armadilhas de dívida e assimetria de informação. Enquadra-se no objeto B por tratar do inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/habitual e da figura do devedor contumaz/recorrente, com foco na repetição e injustificabilidade do inadimplemento, além de oferecer uma leitura comparativa entre gêneros que desafia estereótipos (ex.: defaults por parte dos homens). Não é sobre modelagem macroeconômica de risco sem inadimplemento deliberado nem sobre inadimplência incidental, mantendo-se alinhado ao escopo ao evidenciar o conceito de wilful/default e seus drivers.
justificativa_ia2: Estudo sobre diferenças de gênero nos determinantes da inadimplência, focando armadilhas de dívida e insuficiência de renda; não aborda inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/contumaz nem critérios de enquadramento (valor, reiteração, injustificabilidade).

titulo: A study of loan performance, NPAs and net profit in new private banks of India
resumo: This paper studies the Loan Performance, Non Performing Assets (NPA) and Net Profit of new private banks in India between the time periods 2009-14. Private banking has witnessed growth. In this paper the author(s) examine some of the important measures of bank performance. These measures are indicators of the financial soundness or otherwise of banks. In addition to these measures the author(s) also study the growth in loan performance of new privae sector banks as this helps us understand the credit offtake in the economy. In continuation to the loan perfromance, Non-performing Assets (NPAs) are generally the result of either bad lending or wilful default. The impact of such NPAs is reflected in the net profit of banks, in the form of either loan write-offs or provisioning. By studying these related areas therefore it is possible to understand the performance of a bank better. In this paper an attempt has been made to evaluate the performance of new private banks on these parameters. By examining the relationship among banks equity, assets and deposit size to profitability such as ROE, ROA and NIM the paper is expected to be of help to the banking industry for the improvement or changes in their business model.
justificativa_ia1: O estudo aborda desempenho de bancos, NPAs e menção a 'wilful default', mas não apresenta enquadramento explícito nem análise de inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico/hábito nem da figura de devedor contumaz; a pertinência ao objeto é incerta, exigindo avaliação mais detalhada do conteúdo.
justificativa_ia2: Estudo sobre desempenho bancário e NPAs em bancos privados da Índia; a menção a 'wilful default' é pontual e não há análise específica de inadimplemento deliberado/estratégico, nem enquadramento por valor, reiteração ou injustificabilidade. Trata-se de análise macro de desempenho/NPAs, fora do escopo da busca B.

titulo: Role of Technology for Credit Risk Management: A Bibliometric Review
resumo: Technology has disrupted processes and dynamics of the market. Banking sector and financial institutions are struggling to manage the nonperforming assets. Willful default cases have become a concern. This paper examines the role of technology in credit risk management. Bibliometric analysis was done on Scopus database. The visualization was done using VOS viewer version 1.6.19. 86 documents were obtained in Scopus database. Credit management using technology has attracted the attention of researchers. 46% documents have been published between 2019 and 2022. Fintech credit appraisal, credit default learning algorithms and efficiency of credit assessment using technology emerged as the major research themes. Adoption of blockchain and AI for credit risk assessment eliminates the subjective human bias and brings transparency in credit management. © 2023 IEEE.
